lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Zn6Sb2N6 (reduced formula Zn3SbN3) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 194), with 14 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral SbN6 and ZnN6 environments, with both N centers and Zn centers surrounded by six geometric neighbors, the N–Zn distances ranging from about 2.18 to 2.23 Å. The computed polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between N-centered octahedra, corner- and edge-sharing between Sb- and Zn-centered octahedra, and edge-sharing between Zn-centered octahedra.
